scope: PHANTOM packaged wafer-bar experiment; measured pick/carry/place and pick/lift dynamics replay, synchronized native tactile comparison, and existing-policy interface
configuration_values_policy: This manifest classifies parameter provenance by config path; each run's effective_config.json is authoritative for numerical values.

recorded_measurements.source: Selected episode Zarr streams opened mode=r by tools/sim/prepare_waffles.py
recorded_measurements.units: q radians; qd radians/second; TCP base-frame xyz metres and rotation-vector radians; gripper POS/255 and categorical OBJ
recorded_measurements.limits: Recorded feedback is the motion reference. Wrist F/T is the CB3 current-based estimate; tactile stream units/calibration must be interpreted using their hardware configuration.

recorded_measurements.rule: Zarr ts already contains MasterClock seconds; subtract one shared t0_master only. Preserve metadata clock offset for audit and never apply it a second time.
recorded_measurements.export: Native per-stream times remain under native_<stream>_t; media grid and camera snap errors are separate.

hardware_configuration_evidence.basis: Dashboard-read note dated 2026-07-17 reports Polyscope 3.14.3 and serial 2018333547.
hardware_configuration_evidence.caveat: generation:e-series in the YAML is a documented schema workaround, not evidence for UR3e.

hardware_configuration_evidence.source: configs/hardware.nuc.yaml gripper.stroke_mm/max_close_cmd and pad-contact calibration note
hardware_configuration_evidence.caveat: Hardware bare stroke85mm remains configured evidence. Simulation gripper.stroke70mm is a fitted effective custom-pad gap, not a hardware measurement.

hardware_configuration_evidence.value: D435 RGB 640x480, configured 15 Hz, depth disabled, wrist disabled
hardware_configuration_evidence.source: configs/hardware.nuc.yaml cameras; selected episode stream inventory

hardware_configuration_evidence.value: Configured 125 Hz executor/RTDE, 15 Hz scene RGB, 8 Hz tactile. Actual acquisition intervals remain in native timestamps.
hardware_configuration_evidence.caveat: Physics dt is a numerical setting, not the hardware command period.

nominal_cad.caveat: Not serial-specific factory kinematic calibration; custom gripper and mount are not part of this model.
Visual-only linkage with estimated closure mapping; historic model omits DM-Tac pads/mounts and does not validate physical mimic coupling.

visual_estimates.basis: BalancedC camera-only registration against uncertain CAD wrist/forearm landmarks, pad shells, bin rim and initial packet quad in September4 fit episode; frozen physical scene.
assumptions: Principal point fixed to image center
All image annotations carry stated uncertainties; approximate TCP pixel anchors fromv1 excluded
visual_estimates.caveat: In-sample image registration is not hardware calibration or held-out alignment.

visual_estimates.basis: Image/contact-constrained effective support plane is75mm abovev1, tabletop+53mm in UR base. Scene dimensions and initial packet pose remain estimates; fitting successful grasps does not measure actual mounting height.
visual_estimates.caveat: No ruler measurement, depth or independent object-pose truth recovered. Perforations are visual details over a continuous table collider.

visual_estimates.basis: Pad center/yaw retain v1 visual estimates. Contact hulls and effective aperture were subsequently fitted against both measured successful recordings; these are task-fit estimates.
visual_estimates.caveat: Custom pad/mount geometry, gripper alignment and lighting are unmeasured estimates. Visible white-shell centers differ from contact faces; centroid fit retains substantial model bias.

visual_estimates.method: Projective rectification and bicubic resampling of measured RGB; no generated replacement
visual_estimates.caveat: Carries source lighting and resolution limits; not a measured material reflectance map. No real-scene camera backdrop is used.

visual_estimates.method: Perspective rectification of visible green wrapper in real August22 final frame; no generated/inpainted pixels.
visual_estimates.caveat: Low source resolution and illumination remain in texture.

uncalibrated_physical_parameters.basis: Engineering priors for a rigid packaged wafer bar
uncalibrated_physical_parameters.required_measurement: Mass, dimensions, slide/pull tests, drop/release response, wrapper flex and fracture behavior

uncalibrated_physical_parameters.basis: Engineering contact priors; PhysX material friction combines the contacting surfaces
uncalibrated_physical_parameters.required_measurement: Surface friction under relevant normal loads, gel contact force/deformation curves, slip and retention trials

uncalibrated_physical_parameters.basis: Stable simulation drive settings, not identified UR servoJ or Robotiq motor parameters
uncalibrated_physical_parameters.required_measurement: Timestamped response to accepted targets across loads, speed/force settings and aperture range

uncalibrated_physical_parameters.required_validation: Physics-clock consistency, solver/time-step sensitivity and collision penetration checks

observation_models.tactile_contact_proxy: Policy uses uncalibrated centered Gaussian pressure/depth/gel approximation from physical net pad contact forces at accumulated nominal8Hz deadlines; shear/slip/optical response uncalibrated.
observation_models.wrist_contact_proxy: Pad force/torque sum with recorded initial wrist bias; does not reproduce pose/current-dependent CB3 F/T estimation.
observation_models.zero_ablation: Explicit absent-signal experiment, not a calibrated sensor simulation.
observation_models.gripper_obj: Proxy derived from physical closure, requested target and contact, not actual Robotiq firmware.
observation_models.tactile_video_proxy: Native real infer images with causal timestamps versus synthetic grayscale pressure based on packet-filtered PhysX normal force and force-weighted contact centroid. Body-level contacts include backing/linkage; not calibrated gel-image projection.
observation_models.native_tactile_video: Lossless timestamped image sidecars, previous sample only, age/no-sample/stale labels; SDK wrench/depth values not equated with Newtons/metres.

fixed_episode_split.meaning: Held out from scene fitting, not audited for exclusion from policy training.
fixed_episode_split.session_caveat: Camera/scene appearance changes across dates; August 22 wrapper is green and September wrapper is cream/red.

interpretation_limits: Fit August22 sequence picks, carries and releases a free packet into the bin; its declared contact onset gate is early and image p95 gate remains outside tolerance.
Fit September4 lift passes the declared physical and conditional image-proxy gates.
Heldout5066 matches lift/retention outcome but its contact/lift timing differs; other heldouts retain documented qualitative outcome and external-human-perturbation caveats.
No calibrated real object3D pose or force/tactile transfer is available. Thresholds are engineering checks, not lab-validated transfer bounds.
Updated geometry has not been subjected to a new closed-loop checkpoint success evaluation.

calibration_acceptance_work: Measure serial-specific robot/TCP/pad frames, mounting geometry, aperture mapping and packet size/mass.
Recover camera intrinsics/distortion/extrinsics and evaluate withheld fiducials across the workspace.
Identify motor/contact response through motion, closure, slide, squeeze, lift and release trials; verify collision surfaces.
Match sensor timing, noise and preprocessing; calibrate tactile observation transfer or report explicit ablations.
Freeze settings and acceptance thresholds before held-out replay and matched real/sim policy trials, including failures.

runtime.nccl_workaround: Source Isaac setup_python_env.sh; preload kit/libcarb.so and the matching bundled extsDeprecated/omni.isaac.ml_archive/pip_prebundle/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2 before Kit Python imports Torch.

task_fit_parameters.gripper.contact_shape: 48-segment extruded ellipse for pad/backing/linkage with retained physical colliders; replaces box corners that jammed on support surfaces.
task_fit_parameters.gripper.stroke: 70mm effective custom-pad open gap, supported by a coupled shell/aperture estimate and fit-recording retention; bare hardware stroke remains85mm.
task_fit_parameters.table.top_z: Effective+53mm support plane (v1−22mm plus75mm adjustment); actual table/mount geometry remains unresolved.
task_fit_parameters.waffle.center_and_yaw: One configured initial pose per recording appearance; no pose writes during measured dynamics.
physical_fields_unchanged_from_v1: joint/finger drive stiffness, damping and force limits

revision1_validation.status: prototype_campaign_complete; recorded pickup and physical sensor transfer remain unvalidated
revision1_validation.synthetic_contact_result: Lower-pose probe retained a free packet through a 96.51 mm lift and released it, with zero IK rejections. The first high-start probe failed reach/control. Neither establishes recorded-pickup parity.
interpretation_limits: Direct-pose replay is geometric; its contact outcome is not physics validation.
Full RGB MAE is appearance error; blue-bin silhouette IoU is an uncalibrated static geometry proxy.
Native-feedback tracking and asset/FK consistency do not establish realistic retention.
Rule-derived recorded success labels are not independent lab verdicts.
Current pickup mismatch prevents exact one-to-one scene or validated policy-task claims.
